entries.source: Portfolio Turnover
entries.zh: 组合周转

entries.source: The Fund pays transaction costs, such as commissions, when it buys and sells securities (or “turns over” its portfolio). A higher portfolio turnover rate may indicate higher transaction costs and may result in higher taxes when Fund shares are held in a taxable account. These costs, which are not reflected in annual fund operating expenses, or in the Example, affect the Fund’s performance.
entries.zh: 基金买卖证券（即组合“周转”）时会支付佣金等交易成本。较高的组合周转率可能意味着较高的交易成本；在应税账户持有基金份额时，也可能导致较高税款。这些成本未反映在年度基金运营费用或示例中，但会影响基金表现。

entries.source: What are the Fund’s main investment strategies?
entries.zh: 基金的主要投资策略是什么？

entries.source: The Fund is a non-diversified equity portfolio which is normally managed as a core portfolio, but which has the ability to proactively invest more heavily in either growth or value securities depending on market conditions and the convictions of the adviser. The Fund invests in a limited number of U.S. equity securities, generally not more than 40. In choosing securities, the Fund seeks to invest in companies with one or more of the following characteristics:
entries.zh: 基金为非分散化股票组合，通常作为核心组合管理，但可根据市场条件及投资顾问的判断，主动增加成长型或价值型证券的比重。基金投资于数量有限的美国权益证券，一般不超过40只。选择证券时，基金寻求具有以下一项或多项特征的公司：

entries.source: JPMorgan Equity Focus Fund (continued)
entries.zh: 基金M（续）

entries.source: Ÿ
A durable franchise
entries.zh: 持久的业务基础

entries.source: Ÿ
A sustainable competitive position relative to its peers
entries.zh: 相对于同业具有可持续竞争地位

entries.source: Ÿ
A market leader
entries.zh: 市场领导者

entries.source: Ÿ
A strong management team focused on increasing shareholder value
entries.zh: 专注于增加股东价值的优秀管理团队

entries.source: Ÿ
A strong balance sheet.
entries.zh: 稳健的资产负债表。

entries.source: The size of the allocation of the Fund to growth and value securities will vary based on market conditions, and the convictions of the adviser each ranging from 35% to 65% of the equity investments in the Fund.
entries.zh: 基金对成长型及价值型证券的配置规模随市场条件及投资顾问的判断而变化，两者各占基金股票投资的35%至65%。

entries.source: Under normal circumstances, the Fund invests at least 80% of its Assets in equity securities. “Assets” means net assets, plus the amount of borrowings for investment purposes. The Fund typically invests in equity securities with market capitalizations of $1 billion or more. In implementing its main strategies, the Fund invests primarily in common stocks and real estate investment trusts (REITs), but it may also invest up to 20% of its assets in common stocks of foreign companies, including depositary receipts.
entries.zh: 正常情况下，基金至少将80%的资产投资于权益证券。“资产”指净资产加上用于投资目的的借款。基金通常投资于市值至少10亿美元的权益证券。实施主要策略时，基金主要投资普通股及房地产投资信托基金（REITs），但也可将不超过资产20%的金额投资于外国公司普通股，包括存托凭证。

entries.source: Derivatives, which are instruments that have a value based on another instrument, exchange rate or index, may be used as substitutes for securities in which the Fund can invest. To the extent the Fund uses derivatives the Fund will primarily use futures contracts to more effectively gain targeted equity exposure from its cash positions.
entries.zh: 衍生工具的价值以其他工具、汇率或指数为基础，可以用来替代基金获准投资的证券。在使用衍生工具时，基金主要利用期货合约，使其现金头寸更有效地取得目标股票敞口。

entries.source: If the Fund’s portfolio managers cannot find attractive investments, the Fund may invest up to 20% of its assets in cash and cash equivalents until appropriate investments are identified.
entries.zh: 如果组合经理未能找到有吸引力的投资，基金可将不超过资产20%的金额投资于现金及现金等价物，直至发现适当投资。

entries.source: Investment Process: In managing the Fund, the portfolio managers employ a process that combines research, valuation and stock selection.
entries.zh: 投资流程：管理基金时，组合经理采用结合研究、估值及股票选择的流程。

entries.source: In selecting growth stocks, the adviser focuses on companies whose revenue growth potential is underappreciated by investors, specifically looking for companies that have a history of above-average growth or which the adviser believes will achieve above-average growth in the future. These companies have one or more of the following characteristics:
entries.zh: 选择成长型股票时，投资顾问关注收入增长潜力未被投资者充分认识的公司，尤其寻找过去增长高于平均水平，或投资顾问认为未来增长将高于平均水平的公司。这些公司具有以下一项或多项特征：

entries.source: Ÿ
A favorable supply/demand imbalance for the company’s product or service
entries.zh: 公司的产品或服务存在有利的供求失衡

entries.source: Ÿ
Underappreciated growth opportunities
entries.zh: 尚未被充分认识的增长机会

entries.source: Ÿ
Differentiated business model
entries.zh: 具有差异化的商业模式

entries.source: Ÿ
Ability to gain market share
entries.zh: 取得市场份额的能力

entries.source: Ÿ
Growth opportunities in emerging industries or those that emerge from industry changes
entries.zh: 新兴行业或行业变化所带来的增长机会

entries.source: In selecting value stocks, the adviser seeks to invest in companies which have durable franchises and which appear to be undervalued and have the ability to grow intrinsic value per share. Companies with durable franchises generally have a sustainable competitive position relative to peers, high returns on capital, a diversified client or asset base and a strong brand.
entries.zh: 选择价值型股票时，投资顾问寻求业务基础持久、看似被低估且能够提高每股内在价值的公司。具有持久业务基础的公司，通常相对于同业具有可持续竞争地位、较高资本回报、多样化客户或资产基础及强大品牌。

entries.source: The adviser may sell a security due to a change in the company’s fundamentals or a change in the original reason for purchase of an investment, or if the adviser no longer considers the security to be attractively valued. Investments may also be sold if a portfolio manager identifies a stock that he believes offers a better investment opportunity or to reallocate the Fund’s assets between growth and value securities.
entries.zh: 公司基本面或原购买理由改变，或者投资顾问不再认为证券估值有吸引力时，可以卖出证券。如果组合经理发现其认为更好的投资机会，或为调整成长型与价值型证券间的基金资产配置，也可以出售投资。

entries.source: The Fund’s Main Investment Risks
entries.zh: 基金的主要投资风险

entries.source: The Fund is subject to management risk and may not achieve its objective if the adviser’s expectations regarding particular securities or markets are not met.
entries.zh: 基金承担管理风险。投资顾问对个别证券或市场的预期未能实现时，基金可能无法实现目标。

entries.source: An investment in this Fund or any other fund may not provide a complete investment program. The suitability of an investment in the Fund should be considered based on the investment objective, strategies and risks described in this Prospectus, considered in light of all of the other investments in your portfolio, as well as your risk tolerance, financial goals and time horizons. You may want to consult with a financial advisor to determine if this Fund is suitable for you.
entries.zh: 本基金或其他基金的投资未必构成完整投资计划。应依据本说明书的投资目标、策略及风险，结合您组合中的其他投资，以及风险承受能力、财务目标及投资期限，判断基金是否适合。您可咨询财务顾问，以确定本基金是否适合您。

entries.source: Equity Market Risk. The price of equity securities may rise or fall because of changes in the broad market or changes in a company’s financial condition, sometimes rapidly or unpredictably. These price movements may result from factors affecting individual companies, sectors or industries selected for the Fund’s portfolio or the securities market as a whole, such as changes in economic or political conditions. When the value of the Fund’s securities goes down, your investment in the Fund decreases in value.
entries.zh: 股票市场风险。权益证券价格可能因广泛市场变化或公司财务状况变化而上涨或下跌，且有时迅速或不可预测。这些变动可以来自影响基金所选公司、板块、行业或整个证券市场的因素，例如经济或政治条件变化。基金证券价值下降时，您在基金中的投资价值也会下降。

entries.source: Non-Diversified Fund Risk. The Fund is non-diversified and typically invests in no more than 40 securities. This increased concentration in fewer issuers may result in the Fund’s shares being more sensitive to economic results of those issuing the securities. The value of the Fund’s shares may also be more volatile than the value of a Fund which invests in more securities.
entries.zh: 非分散化基金风险。基金为非分散化基金，通常投资不超过40只证券。持仓集中于较少发行人，可使份额对这些发行人的经济结果更为敏感。份额价值也可能比投资更多证券的基金更为波动。

entries.source: Strategy Risk. Although the Fund is normally managed as a core portfolio, it may invest more heavily in either growth or value securities depending on market conditions and the convictions of the adviser.
entries.zh: 策略风险。基金通常作为核心组合管理，但可根据市场条件及投资顾问的判断，增加成长型或价值型证券的比重。

entries.source: If the Fund invests more heavily in growth securities, it will be more subject to risks related to growth investing. Specifically, growth stocks may trade at higher multiples of current earnings compared to value or other stocks, leading to inflated prices and thus potentially greater declines in value.
entries.zh: 如果基金较多投资成长型证券，将更多承担成长投资的风险。具体而言，成长股可能以高于价值股或其他股票的当期盈利倍数交易，使价格偏高，并因此可能出现更大幅度的下跌。

entries.source: If the Fund invests more heavily in value securities, it will be more subject to risks related to value investing. Specifically, a value stock may decrease in price or may not increase in price as anticipated by the adviser if other investors fail to recognize the company’s value or the factors that the adviser believes will cause the stock price to increase do not occur.
entries.zh: 如果基金较多投资价值型证券，将更多承担价值投资的风险。具体而言，其他投资者未认可公司价值，或投资顾问认为将使股价上涨的因素未出现时，价值股可能下跌，或无法按投资顾问预期上涨。

entries.source: J.P. MORGAN U.S. EQUITY FUNDS
entries.zh: M系列美国股票基金

entries.source: Smaller Cap Company Risk. Investments in companies with capitalizations as low as $1 billion may be riskier, more volatile and more vulnerable to economic, market and industry changes than investments in larger, more established companies. As a result, share price changes may be more sudden or erratic than the prices of other equity securities, especially over the short term.
entries.zh: 较小市值公司风险。投资市值最低约10亿美元的公司，相比投资规模更大、更成熟的公司，可能风险更高、波动更大，且更易受到经济、市场及行业变化影响。因此，其股价变化可能比其他权益证券更突然或不规则，尤其在短期内。

entries.source: Foreign Securities Risk. Investments in foreign issuers are subject to additional risks, including political and economic risks, greater volatility, civil conflicts and war, currency fluctuations, expropriation and nationalization risks, higher transaction costs, delayed settlement, possible foreign controls on investment and less stringent investor protection and disclosure standards of foreign markets.
entries.zh: 外国证券风险。投资外国发行人承担额外风险，包括政治经济风险、较大波动、内乱及战争、汇率变化、征收及国有化风险、较高交易成本、结算延迟、可能存在的外国投资管制，以及外国市场较不严格的投资者保护和披露标准。

entries.source: Real Estate Securities Risk. The Fund’s investments in real estate securities, including REITs, are subject to the same risks as direct investments in real estate and mortgages, and their value will depend on the value of the underlying real estate interests. These risks include default, prepayments, changes in value resulting from changes in interest rates and demand for real and rental property, and the management skill and credit- worthiness of REIT issuers. The Fund will indirectly bear its proportionate share of expenses, including management fees, paid by each REIT in which it invests in addition to the expenses of the Fund.

entries.source: Main Risks
entries.zh: 主要风险

entries.source: Equity Market Risk. The price of equity securities may rise or fall because of changes in the broad market or changes in a company’s financial condition, sometimes rapidly or unpredictably. These price movements may result from factors affecting individual companies, sectors or industries selected for the Fund’s portfolio or the securities market as a whole,
entries.zh: 股票市场风险。权益证券价格可能因广泛市场或公司财务状况变化而上涨或下跌，有时迅速或不可预测。价格变化可以源自影响组合公司、板块、行业或整个证券市场的因素，

entries.source: such as changes in economic or political conditions. Equity securities are subject to “stock market risk” meaning that stock prices in general (or in particular, the prices of the types of securities in which the Fund invests) may decline over short or extended periods of time. When the value of the Fund’s securities goes down, your investment in the Fund decreases in value.
entries.zh: 例如经济或政治条件变化。权益证券承担“股票市场风险”，即总体股价，或特别是基金投资类型的股价，可能在短期或较长期间下降。基金证券价值下降时，您的基金投资价值也会下降。

entries.source: Strategy Risk. Although the Fund is normally managed as a core portfolio, it may invest more heavily in either growth or value securities depending on market conditions and the convictions of the adviser.
entries.zh: 策略风险。基金通常作为核心组合管理，但可以根据市场条件及投资顾问的判断，增加成长型或价值型证券的比重。

entries.source: If the Fund invests more heavily in growth securities, it will be more subject to risks related to growth investing. Growth investing attempts to identify companies that the adviser believes will experience rapid earnings growth relative to value or other types of stock. The value of these stocks generally is more sensitive to current or expected earnings than stocks of other types of companies. Short-term events, such as a failure to meet industry earnings expectations, can cause dramatic decreases in the growth stock price compared to other types of stock. Growth stocks may also trade at higher multiples of current earnings compared to value or other stocks, leading to inflated prices and thus potentially greater declines in value. During times when the Fund focuses more heavily on growth stocks, the Fund’s performance may be better or worse than the performance of equity funds that focus on value stocks or that have a broader investment style.
entries.zh: 基金较多投资成长型证券时，将更多承担成长投资风险。成长投资旨在识别投资顾问认为相对于价值股或其他股票，盈利增长更快的公司。此类股票的价值通常对当前或预期盈利更为敏感。未达到行业盈利预期等短期事件，可以使成长股相对于其他股票出现较大跌幅。成长股也可能以较高当期盈利倍数交易，使价格偏高，因而可能出现更大跌幅。基金偏重成长股时，其表现可能优于或差于偏重价值股或采用更广泛风格的股票基金。

entries.source: If the Fund invests more heavily in value securities, it will be more subject to risks related to value investing. Value investing attempts to identify companies that, according to the adviser’s estimate of their true worth, are undervalued. The adviser selects stocks at prices that it believes are temporarily low relative to factors such as the company’s earnings, cash flow or dividends. A value stock may decrease in price or may not increase in price as anticipated by the adviser if other investors fail to recognize the company’s value or the factors that the adviser believes will cause the stock price to increase do not occur. During times when the Fund focuses more heavily on value stocks, the Fund’s performance may be better or worse than the performance of equity funds that focus on growth stocks or that have a broader investment style.
entries.zh: 基金较多投资价值型证券时，将更多承担价值投资风险。价值投资旨在识别按投资顾问真实价值估计而被低估的公司。投资顾问选择相对于盈利、现金流或股息等因素，价格暂时偏低的股票。其他投资者未认可公司价值，或投资顾问认为会促使上涨的因素未出现时，价值股可能下跌或无法按预期上涨。基金偏重价值股时，其表现可能优于或差于偏重成长股或采用更广泛风格的股票基金。

entries.source: Smaller Cap Company Risk. Investments in smaller, newer companies may be riskier than investments in larger, more-established companies. The securities of smaller companies may trade less frequently and in smaller volumes than securities of larger companies. In addition, smaller companies may be more vulnerable to economic, market and industry changes. As a result, share price changes may be more sudden or erratic than the prices of large capitalization companies, especially over the short term. Because smaller companies may have limited product lines, markets or financial resources or may depend on a few key employees, they may be more susceptible to particular economic events or competitive factors than large capitalization companies. This may cause unexpected and frequent decreases in the value of the Fund’s investments.
entries.zh: 较小市值公司风险。投资规模较小、成立较晚的公司，可能比投资规模更大、更成熟的公司风险更高。较小公司证券交易频率及数量可能低于大型公司，且可能更易受到经济、市场及行业变化影响。因此，其股价变化可能比大市值公司更突然或不规则，尤其在短期内。较小公司产品线、市场或财务资源可能有限，也可能依赖少数关键员工，因此更易受到特定经济事件或竞争因素影响，导致基金投资价值意外且频繁下降。

entries.source: Foreign Securities Risks. To the extent the Fund invests in foreign securities (including depositary receipts), these investments are subject to special risks in addition to those of U.S. investments. These risks include political and economic risks, greater volatility, civil conflicts and war, currency fluctuations, expropriation and nationalization risks, higher transaction costs, delayed settlement, possible foreign controls on investment, and less stringent investor protection and disclosure standards of foreign markets. The securities markets of many foreign countries are relatively small, with a limited number of companies representing a small number of industries. If foreign securities are denominated and traded in a foreign currency, the value of the Fund’s foreign holdings can be affected by currency exchange rates and exchange control regulations.
entries.zh: 外国证券风险。外国证券，包括存托凭证，除美国投资风险外还承担特殊风险，包括政治经济风险、较大波动、内乱及战争、汇率变化、征收及国有化风险、较高交易成本、结算延迟、外国投资管制，以及较不严格的投资者保护和披露标准。许多外国市场规模相对较小，仅有少数公司及行业。证券以外币计价及交易时，汇率及外汇管制可能影响基金持仓价值。

entries.source: Real Estate Securities Risk. The value of real estate securities in general, and REITs in particular, are subject to the same risks as direct investments in real estate and mortgages and will depend on the value of the underlying properties or the underlying loans or interests. The underlying loans may be subject to the risks of default or of prepayments that occur earlier or later than expected, and such loans may also include so-called “sub-prime” mortgages. The value of these securities will rise and fall in response to many factors, including economic conditions, the demand for rental property, interest rates and, with respect to REITs, the management skill and creditworthiness of the issuer. In particular, the value of these securities may decline when interest rates rise and will also be affected by the real estate market and by the management of the underlying properties. REITs may be more volatile and/or more illiquid than other types of equity securities. The Fund will indirectly bear its proportionate share of expenses, including management fees, paid by each REIT in which they invest in addition to the expenses of the Fund.
entries.zh: 房地产证券风险。房地产证券及REITs承担与直接投资房地产及抵押贷款相同的风险，其价值取决于相关物业、贷款或权益。底层贷款可承担违约及提前偿付早于或迟于预期的风险，并可能包含“次级”抵押贷款。经济状况、租赁需求、利率，以及REIT发行人的管理能力和信用状况影响价格；利率上升时尤其可能下跌。房地产市场及底层物业管理也影响价值。REITs可能比其他股票更波动或更缺乏流动性。基金除自身费用外，还间接承担REIT的按比例费用，包括管理费。

entries.source: Redemption Risk. The Fund may need to sell its holdings in order to meet shareholder redemption requests. The Fund could experience a loss when selling securities to meet redemption requests if the redemption requests are unusually large or frequent, occur in times of overall market turmoil or declining prices for the securities sold, or when the securities the Fund wishes to or is required to sell are illiquid. The Fund may be unable to sell illiquid securities at its desired time or price. Illiquidity can be caused by a drop in overall market trading volume, an inability to find a ready buyer, or legal restrictions on the securities’ resale. Certain securities that were liquid when purchased may later become illiquid, particularly in times of overall economic distress.
entries.zh: 赎回风险。基金可能需要出售持仓满足赎回。如果赎回异常庞大或频繁，发生于市场动荡、相关证券价格下降时，或拟售证券缺乏流动性，基金可能遭受损失。基金可能无法在希望的时间或价格出售不流动证券。整体交易量下降、缺乏买家或转售法律限制均可造成流动性不足；购买时流动性较好的证券也可能随后变得不流动，尤其在经济整体困难时期。

entries.source: Derivatives are securities or contracts (like futures and options) that derive their value from the performance of underlying assets or securities.
entries.zh: 衍生工具是价值来自底层资产或证券表现的证券或合同，例如期货及期权。

entries.source: Investing in derivatives will result in a form of leverage. Leverage involves special risks. The Fund may be more volatile than if the Fund had not been leveraged because the leverage tends to exaggerate any effect of the increase or decrease in the value of the Fund’s portfolio securities. Registered investment companies are limited in their ability to engage in derivative transactions and are required to identify and earmark assets to provide asset coverage for derivative transactions.
entries.zh: 投资衍生工具会形成杠杆。杠杆具有特殊风险，放大组合证券价值上涨或下跌的影响，使基金比未使用杠杆时更为波动。注册投资公司使用衍生交易受到限制，并须识别及标记资产，为衍生交易提供资产覆盖。

entries.source: The Fund’s transactions in futures contracts, swaps and other derivatives could also affect the amount, timing and character of distributions to shareholders which may result in the Fund realizing more short-term capital gain and ordinary income subject to tax at ordinary income tax rates than it would if it did not engage in such transactions, which may adversely impact the Fund’s after-tax return.

entries.source: The J.P. Morgan Funds do not authorize market timing and, except for the Funds identified below, use reasonable methods to identify market timers and to prevent such activity. However, there can be no assurance that these methods will prevent market timing or other trading that may be deemed abusive. Market timing is an investment strategy using frequent purchases, redemptions and/or exchanges in an attempt to profit from short-term market movements. Market timing may result in dilution of the value of Fund shares held by long-term shareholders, disrupt portfolio management and increase Fund expenses for all shareholders. Although market timing may affect any Fund, these risks may be higher for Funds that invest significantly in non-U.S. securities or thinly traded securities (e.g., certain small cap securities), such as international, global or emerging market funds or small cap funds. For example, when a Fund invests in securities trading principally in non-U.S. markets that close prior to the close of the NYSE, market timers may seek to take advantage of the difference between the prices of these securities at the close of their non-U.S. markets and the value of such securities when the Fund calculates its net asset value. The J.P. Morgan Funds or the Distributor will prohibit any purchase order (including exchanges) with respect to one investor, a related group of investors or their agent(s), where they detect a pattern of either purchases and sales of one of the J.P. Morgan Funds, or exchanges between or among the J.P. Morgan Funds, that indicates market timing or trading that they determine is abusive.
entries.zh: M系列不允许市场择时，除下列基金外，采用合理方法识别并阻止此类活动，但不能保证阻止全部市场择时或其他被认为滥用的交易。市场择时指通过频繁购买、赎回及／或交换，试图从短期市场变动获利，可能稀释长期持有份额的价值、干扰组合管理并增加全体持有人的基金费用。虽然可影响任何基金，但大量投资非美国证券或交易稀少证券（如某些小市值证券）的国际、全球、新兴市场或小市值基金，风险可能更高。例如，主要在NYSE收市前已经收市的非美国市场交易的证券，市场择时者可以利用外国收市价格与基金计算净值时价值之间的差异。如果发现单个投资者、关联投资者群体或其代理的系列基金购买出售或基金间交换模式，显示市场择时或被认为滥用的交易，系列或分销机构将禁止相关购买订单，包括交换。

entries.source: The J.P. Morgan Funds’ Board of Trustees has adopted policies and procedures that use a variety of methods to identify market timers, including reviewing “round trips” in and out of the J.P. Morgan Funds by investors. A “round trip” includes a purchase or exchange into a Fund followed or preceded by a redemption or exchange out of the same Fund. If the Distributor detects that you have completed two round trips within 60 days in the same Fund, the Distributor will reject your purchase and exchange orders for a period of at least 90 days. For subsequent violations, the Distributor may, in its sole discretion, reject your purchase and exchange orders temporarily or permanently. In identifying market timers, the Distributor may also consider activity of accounts that it believes to be under common ownership or control.
entries.zh: 受托人委员会采用多种方法识别市场择时，包括检查投资者的“往返交易”。往返交易指购买或交换进入基金，随后或此前赎回或交换退出同一基金。分销机构发现同一基金60日内发生两次往返交易，将拒绝购买及交换订单至少90日。再次违反时，可以自行决定临时或永久拒绝订单。识别时亦可考虑其认为属共同所有或控制的账户活动。

entries.source: Market timers may disrupt portfolio management and harm Fund performance. To the extent that the J.P. Morgan Funds are unable to identify market timers effectively, long-term investors may be adversely affected. Although the J.P. Morgan Funds use a variety of methods to detect and deter market timing, there is no assurance that the Funds’ own operational systems and procedures will identify and eliminate all market-timing strategies. For example, certain accounts, which are known as omnibus accounts, include multiple investors and such accounts typically provide the Funds with a net purchase or redemption order on any given day where purchasers of Fund shares and redeemers of Fund shares are netted against one another and the identity of individual purchasers and redeemers are not known by the Funds. While the Funds seek to monitor for market timing activities in omnibus accounts, the netting effect limits the Funds’ ability to locate and eliminate individual market timers. As a result, the Funds are often dependent upon Financial Intermediaries who utilize their own policies and procedures to identify market timers. These policies and procedures may be different than those utilized by the Funds.
entries.zh: 市场择时可干扰组合管理并损害表现，未能有效识别时可不利于长期投资者。虽然采用多种方法识别和阻止，但不保证运营系统及程序识别并排除全部择时策略。例如，“综合账户”包含多个投资者，一般每天仅向基金提供净购买或赎回订单，将购买者与赎回者相互抵销，个人身份不为基金所知。基金虽监控此类账户，但净额效果限制识别和排除个人择时者的能力，因此常依赖中介采用其自身政策；其政策可能不同于基金。

entries.source: What kind of shares can I buy?

entries.source: This prospectus offers Class A, Class C and Select Class Shares. Class A and Class C Shares are available to the general public. Select Class Shares are available to those investors meeting the class’ minimum and eligibility requirements.

Sales charges are discussed in the section of this prospectus entitled “Sales Charges.”

entries.source: Your decision about which class of shares to buy depends on a number of factors, including the number of shares you are buying and how long you intend to hold your shares. Class A Shares may be a good choice if you qualify to have the sales charge reduced or eliminated.

entries.source: How much do shares cost?
entries.zh: 份额价格是多少？

entries.source: Shares are sold at net asset value (NAV) per share. This is also known as the offering price.
entries.zh: 份额按每份净资产值（NAV）出售，也称发行价格。

entries.source: Each class of shares in the Fund has a different NAV. This is primarily because each share class has different distribution expenses.
entries.zh: 每类净值不同，主要由于分销费用不同。

entries.source: NAV per share is calculated by dividing the total market value of the Fund’s investments and other assets allocable to a class (minus class liabilities) by the number of outstanding shares in that class.
entries.zh: 每份净值以归属于某类别的基金投资及其他资产总市值减去类别负债，再除以该类别流通份额数计算。

entries.source: The market value of the Fund’s investments is determined primarily on the basis of readily available market quotations. Certain short-term securities are valued at amortized cost, which approximates market value. If market quotations are not readily available or if available market quotations are determined not to be reliable or if a security’s value has been materially affected by events occurring after the close of trading on the exchange or market on which the security is principally traded (for example, a natural disaster affecting an entire country or region, or an event that affects an individual company), but before the Fund’s NAV is calculated, that security may be valued at its fair value in accordance with policies and procedures adopted by the J.P. Morgan Funds’ Board of Trustees. A security’s valuation may differ depending on the method used for determining value. In addition, the
entries.zh: 投资市值主要根据可取得的市场报价确定。某些短期证券采用接近市值的摊余成本估值。如果不能取得报价、报价被认定不可靠，或者证券主要交易市场收市后、基金计算净值前发生的事件（如影响整个国家或地区的自然灾害或影响单个公司的事件）对价值产生重大影响，可按受托人委员会政策及程序确定公允价值。不同估值方法可能形成不同估值。此外，

Morgan Funds’ Board of Trustees, determines that the pricing service quotations do not accurately reflect the value of a security and determines that the use of another fair valuation methodology is appropriate.
entries.zh: 除北美、中美、南美及加勒比地区权益证券外，M系列对其全部权益证券每天实施公允价值定价，使用独立定价机构报价；但顾问按委员会估值程序判断报价不能准确反映价值、且适合另一公允估值方法的除外。

entries.source: The Fund’s NAV may change every day. NAV is calculated each business day following the close of the NYSE at 4:00 p.m. ET. On occasion, the NYSE will close before 4:00 p.m. ET. When that happens, NAV will be calculated as of the time the NYSE closes. The price at which a purchase is effected is based on the next calculation of NAV after the order is accepted in accordance with this prospectus. To the extent the Fund invests in securities that are primarily listed on foreign exchanges that trade on weekends or other days when the Fund does not price its shares, the value of the Fund’s shares may change on days when you will not be able to purchase or redeem your shares.
entries.zh: 净值可每天变化。每个营业日NYSE于东部时间下午4时收市后计算净值；提前收市时按收市时计算。购买价格以按本说明书接受订单后下一次净值计算为准。若基金主要上市于在周末或基金不计价日期交易的外国市场，您不能购买或赎回时份额价值仍可能变化。

entries.source: RULE 12b-1 FEES
entries.zh: 12b-1规则费用

entries.source: The Fund described in this prospectus has adopted a Distribution Plan under Rule 12b-1 with respect to Class A and Class C Shares that allows it to pay distribution fees for the sale and distribution of those shares of the Fund. These fees are called “Rule 12b-1 fees.” Rule 12b-1 fees are paid by the Fund to the Distributor as compensation for its services and expenses in connection with the sale and distribution of Fund shares. The Distributor in turn pays all or part of these Rule 12b-1 fees to Financial Intermediaries that have agreements with the Distributor to sell shares of the Fund. The Distributor may pay Rule 12b-1 fees to its affiliates. Payments are not tied to actual expenses incurred.
entries.zh: 本说明书中的基金就A及B采用12b-1规则下的分销计划，允许为有关份额的销售及分销支付费用。这些费用称为“12b-1规则费用”，由基金支付给分销机构，补偿份额销售及分销相关服务和支出。分销机构将全部或部分款项付给与其订有基金销售协议的中介，也可付给关联方。付款不与实际支出挂钩。

entries.source: A redemption order must be supported by all appropriate documentation and information in proper form. The Fund may refuse to honor incomplete redemption orders.

entries.source: How do I redeem shares?
entries.zh: 如何赎回？

entries.source: You may use any of the following methods to redeem your shares.
entries.zh: 可以采用以下任何一种方式。

entries.source: You may send a written redemption request to your Financial Intermediary, if applicable, or to the Fund at the following address:
entries.zh: 适用时向中介提交书面申请，或邮寄至基金以下地址：

entries.source: J.P. Morgan Funds Services
entries.zh: M基金服务机构

entries.source: P.O. Box 8528
entries.zh: ［匿名化邮政信箱］

entries.source: Boston, MA 02266-8528
entries.zh: ［匿名化城市及邮编］

entries.source: You may redeem over the telephone. Please see “Can I redeem by telephone?” for more information.
entries.zh: 也可电话赎回，更多资料见“可以电话赎回吗？”

entries.source: We will need the names of the registered shareholders and your account number and other information before we can sell your shares.
entries.zh: 出售之前需要登记持有人姓名、账户号码等资料。

entries.source: You may also need to have medallion signature guarantees for all registered owners or their legal representatives if:
entries.zh: 以下情况下，可能要求全部登记持有人或法律代表提供合格的奖章式签名保证：

entries.source: Ÿ
You want to redeem shares with a value of $50,000 or more and you want to receive your proceeds in the form of a check; or
entries.zh: 赎回至少50,000美元并要求以支票收款；或

entries.source: Ÿ
You want your payment sent to an address, bank account or payee other than the one currently designated on your Fund account.
entries.zh: 要求支付至基金账户登记之外的地址、银行账户或收款人。

entries.source: J.P. MORGAN U.S. EQUITY FUNDS
entries.zh: M系列美国股票基金

entries.source: On the Account Application you may elect to have the redemption proceeds mailed or wired to:
entries.zh: 可在开户申请选择将赎回款邮寄或电汇至：

entries.source: A financial institution; or
entries.zh: 金融机构；或

entries.source: Your Financial Intermediary.
entries.zh: 您的金融中介。

entries.source: Normally, your redemption proceeds will be paid within one to seven days after receipt of the redemption order. If you have changed your address of record within the previous 30 days, the Fund will not mail your proceeds, but rather will wire them or send them by ACH to a pre-existing bank account on record with the Fund.
entries.zh: 通常在赎回订单收到后一至七日付款。此前30日内更改登记地址的，不邮寄，而电汇或通过ACH支付至基金已登记银行账户。

entries.source: The Fund may hold proceeds for shares purchased by ACH or check until the purchase amount has been collected, which may be as long as five business days.
entries.zh: ACH或支票购买的赎回款可以暂缓至购买款收妥，最多可能需要五个营业日。

entries.source: What will my shares be worth?
entries.zh: 份额值多少？

entries.source: If the Fund or a Financial Intermediary receives your redemption order before 4:00 p.m. ET (or before the NYSE closes if the NYSE closes before 4:00 p.m. ET), you will receive the NAV per share calculated after your redemption order is received in good order, minus any applicable CDSC.
entries.zh: 基金或中介在东部时间下午4时前（或提前收市前）收到完整订单的，支付其后计算的每份净值，减适用递延销售费。

entries.source: Can I redeem by telephone?
entries.zh: 可以电话赎回吗？

entries.source: Yes, if you selected this option on your Account Application.
entries.zh: 可以，须在开户申请选择该权限。

entries.source: Contact your Financial Intermediary, if applicable, or call 1-800-480-4111 to relay your redemption request.
entries.zh: 请联系中介或［匿名化服务电话］发出赎回指令。

entries.source: Your redemption proceeds will be mailed to you at your address of record or wired. If you have changed your address of record within the previous 30 days, the Fund will not mail your proceeds, but rather will wire them or send them by ACH to a pre-existing bank account on record with the Fund.
entries.zh: 款项邮寄至登记地址或电汇。此前30日内地址变更的，不邮寄，而电汇或ACH支付至预先登记银行账户。

entries.source: The Fund uses reasonable procedures to confirm that instructions given by telephone are genuine. These procedures include recording telephone instructions and asking for personal identification. If these procedures are followed, the Fund will not be responsible for any loss, liability, cost or expense of acting upon unauthorized or fraudulent instructions; you bear the risk of loss.
entries.zh: 基金采用合理程序确认电话指令真实，包括录音及核实个人身份。遵守程序时，依未经授权或欺诈指令办理所致损失、责任、成本或费用，不由基金承担；您承担损失风险。

entries.source: You may not always reach J.P. Morgan Funds Services by telephone. This may be true at times of unusual market changes and shareholder activity. You can mail us your instructions or contact your Financial Intermediary. We may modify or cancel the ability to purchase or redeem shares by phone without notice.
entries.zh: 电话可能不能始终接通，尤其市场异常变化或持有人活动较多时。可以邮寄指令或联系中介。基金可以不经通知变更或取消电话购买及赎回权限。

entries.source: You may write to:
entries.zh: 书面申请可送至：

entries.source: J.P. Morgan Funds Services
entries.zh: M基金服务机构

entries.source: P.O. Box 8528
entries.zh: ［匿名化邮政信箱］

entries.source: Boston, MA 02266-8528
entries.zh: ［匿名化城市及邮编］

entries.source: Can I redeem on a systematic basis?
entries.zh: 可以系统提款吗？

entries.source: Yes, with respect only to Class A and Class C Shares.
entries.zh: 可以，仅适用于A及B。

entries.source: Ÿ
Select the “Systematic Withdrawal Plan” option on the Account Application.
entries.zh: 在开户申请选择“系统提款计划”。

entries.source: Ÿ
Specify the amount you wish to receive and the frequency of the payments.
entries.zh: 指定所需金额及支付频率。

entries.source: Ÿ
You may designate a person other than yourself as the payee.
entries.zh: 可以指定他人作为收款人。

entries.source: Ÿ
There is no fee for this service.
entries.zh: 本服务不收费。

entries.source: If you select this option, please keep in mind that:
entries.zh: 选择时请注意：

entries.source: Ÿ

It may not be in your best interest to buy additional Class A Shares while participating in a Systematic Withdrawal Plan. This is because Class A Shares have an up-front sales charge. If you own Class C Shares, you or your designated payee may receive monthly, quarterly or annual systematic payments. The applicable Class C CDSC will be deducted from those payments unless such payments are made:
entries.zh: 参加系统提款时追加购买A可能不符合您的利益，因为A收前端销售费。持有B时，您或指定收款人可以按月、季度或年度领取系统付款。适用递延销售费从付款中扣除，除非付款：

entries.source: Ÿ
Monthly and constitute no more than 1/12 of 10% of your then-current balance in the Fund each month; or
entries.zh: 按月，每次不超过当时基金账户余额10%的十二分之一；或

entries.source: Ÿ
Quarterly and constitute no more than 1/4 of 10% of your then-current balance in the Fund each quarter.
entries.zh: 按季度，每次不超过当时余额10%的四分之一。

entries.source: The amount of the CDSC charged will depend on whether your systematic payments are a fixed dollar amount per month or quarter or are calculated monthly or quarterly as a stated percentage of your then-current balance in the Fund. For more information about the calculation of the CDSC for systematic withdrawals exceeding the specified limits above, please see the Fund’s Statement of Additional Information. New annual systematic withdrawals are not eligible for a waiver of the applicable Class C CDSC. Your current balance in the Fund for purposes of these calculations will be determined by multiplying the number of shares held by the then-current NAV per share of the applicable class.
entries.zh: 递延销售费金额取决于付款为每月或季度固定美元金额，还是按当时余额的一定比例计算。超过上述比例的计算详情见补充信息说明书。新设年度系统提款不能豁免B递延销售费。此处当前余额为份额数乘以相应类别当时每份净值。

entries.source: If the amount of the systematic payment exceeds the income earned by your account since the previous payment under the Systematic Withdrawal Plan, payments will be made by redeeming some of your shares. This will reduce the amount of your investment.
entries.zh: 付款超过自前次付款以来赚取的账户收入时，将赎回部分份额支付，减少投资额。

entries.source: You cannot have both a Systematic Investment Plan and a Systematic Withdrawal Plan for the Fund.
entries.zh: 同一基金不能同时采用系统投资及系统提款计划。

entries.source: Additional Information Regarding Redemptions
entries.zh: 赎回的补充资料

entries.source: Generally, all redemptions will be for cash. However, if you redeem shares worth $250,000 or more, the Fund reserves the right to pay part or all of your redemption proceeds in readily marketable securities instead of cash. If payment is made in
entries.zh: 一般全部赎回以现金支付。但赎回至少250,000美元时，基金保留以易变现证券而非现金支付部分或全部款项的权利。若以

entries.zh: 证券支付，其估值方法与计算基金净值时相同，以尽量降低大型赎回对基金及其他持有人的影响。

entries.source: Due to the relatively high cost of maintaining small accounts, if your account value falls below the required minimum balance, the Fund reserves the right to redeem all of the remaining shares in your account and close your account or charge an annual sub-minimum account fee of $10. Before either of these actions is taken, you will be given 60 days’ advance written notice in order to provide you with time to increase your account balance to the required minimum by purchasing sufficient shares, in accordance with the terms of this prospectus. Accounts participating in a qualifying Systematic Investment Plan will not be subject to redemption fees or the imposition of the $10 fee as long as the systematic payments to be made will increase the account value above the required minimum balance within one year of the establishment of the account.
entries.zh: 小额账户维护成本相对较高。余额低于最低要求时，基金保留赎回全部剩余份额、关闭账户，或每年收取10美元低余额账户费的权利。行动前提前60日书面通知，使您可按本说明书增购足够份额恢复余额。合资格系统投资账户，如定期付款将在开户一年内达到最低余额，不适用有关赎回或10美元费用。

entries.source: To collect the $10 sub-minimum account fee, the Fund will redeem $10 worth of shares from your account. Shares redeemed for this reason will not be charged a CDSC, if applicable.
entries.zh: 为收10美元低余额费，将赎回相应价值份额，此项赎回不收适用递延销售费。

entries.source: If your account falls below the minimum required balance and is closed as a result, you will not be charged a CDSC, if applicable. For information on minimum required balances, please read “Purchasing Fund Shares — How do I open an account?”
entries.zh: 因余额不足关闭账户的，不收适用递延销售费。最低余额资料见“购买基金份额—如何开户？”上述低余额收费及关闭安排不适用于本说明书所涵盖渠道的账户；该渠道不因余额不足收取维护费或强制赎回。

entries.zh: 下列情况下，可以暂停赎回：

entries.zh: NYSE交易受到限制；

entries.source: The NYSE is closed (other than weekend and holiday closings);
entries.zh: NYSE休市，正常周末和假日休市除外；

entries.source: Federal securities laws permit;
entries.zh: 联邦证券法律允许；

entries.source: The SEC has permitted a suspension; or
entries.zh: SEC许可暂停；或

entries.source: An emergency exists, as determined by the SEC.
entries.zh: SEC认定存在紧急情况。

entries.source: See “Purchases, Redemptions and Exchanges” in the Statement of Additional Information for more details about this process.
entries.zh: 过程详情见补充信息说明书“购买、赎回及交换”。

entries.source: You generally will recognize a gain or loss on a redemption for federal income tax purposes. You should talk to your tax advisor before making a redemption.
entries.zh: 赎回一般为联邦所得税目的产生利得或损失。赎回前请咨询税务顾问。

entries.source: DISTRIBUTIONS AND TAXES
entries.zh: 分配与税务

entries.source: The Fund intends to elect to be treated and qualify each year as a regulated investment company. A regulated investment company is not subject to tax at the corporate level on income and gains from investments that are distributed to shareholders. The Fund’s failure to qualify as a regulated investment company would result in corporate-level taxation and, consequently, a reduction in income available for distribution to shareholders. The Fund can earn income and realize capital gain.
entries.zh: 基金拟选择并每年符合受监管投资公司资格。此类公司不对已分配给持有人的投资收入及利得在公司层面征税。未符合资格将产生公司层面税负，减少可分配收入。基金可赚取收入并实现资本利得。

entries.source: The Fund deducts any expenses and then pays out these earnings, if any, to shareholders as distributions.
entries.zh: 基金扣除费用后，将这些收入（如有）以分配方式支付持有人。

entries.source: The Fund generally distributes net investment income, if any, at least annually. The Fund will distribute its net realized capital gains, if any, at least annually. For each taxable year, the Fund will distribute substantially all of its net investment income and net realized capital gains.
entries.zh: 基金通常至少每年分配净投资收入及已实现净资本利得（如有）。每个应税年度，将分配基本全部净投资收入及净已实现资本利得。

entries.source: You have three options for your distributions. You may:
entries.zh: 分配有三种选择，您可以：

entries.source: Ÿ
reinvest all distributions in additional Fund shares without a sales charge;
entries.zh: 全部分配再投资购买更多份额，不收销售费；

entries.source: Ÿ
take distributions of net investment income in cash or as a deposit in a pre-assigned bank account and reinvest distributions of net capital gain in additional shares; or
entries.zh: 净投资收入以现金或预设银行账户领取，净资本利得再投资；或

entries.source: Ÿ
take all distributions in cash or as a deposit in a pre-assigned bank account.
entries.zh: 全部分配以现金或预设银行账户领取。

entries.source: If you do not select an option when you open your account, we will reinvest all distributions. If your distributions are reinvested, they will be in the form of shares of the same class. The taxation of dividends will not be affected by the form in which you receive them.
entries.zh: 开户时未选择的，全部再投资于同类份额。股息税务处理不受领取形式影响。

entries.source: For federal income tax purposes, distributions of net investment income generally are taxable as ordinary income. Dividends of net investment income paid to a non-corporate U.S. shareholder during a taxable year beginning before January 1, 2013 that are properly designated as qualified dividend income generally will be taxable to such shareholder at a maximum rate of 15%. The amount of dividend income that may be so designated by the Fund generally will be limited to the aggregate of the eligible dividends received by the Fund. In addition, the Fund must meet certain holding period and other requirements with respect to the shares on which the Fund received the eligible dividends, and the non-corporate U.S. shareholder must meet certain holding period and other requirements with respect to the Fund shares. Dividends of net investment income that are not designated as qualified dividend income will be taxable as ordinary income.
entries.zh: 联邦所得税下，净投资收入分配一般按普通收入征税。2013年1月1日前开始的应税年度，支付给非公司美国持有人的净投资收入股息，如适当指定为合资格股息收入，一般最高税率15%。基金指定金额通常不超过取得的合资格股息总额。基金须满足底层股份持有期等条件，持有人也须满足基金份额持有期等要求。未指定为合资格股息的净投资收入股息按普通收入征税。

entries.source: Distributions of net capital gain (that is, the excess of the net gains from the sale of investments that the Fund owned for
entries.zh: 净资本利得分配（指持有

entries.source: more than one year over the net losses from investments the Fund owned for one year or less) that are properly designated by the Fund as capital gain dividends will be taxable as long-term capital gain, regardless of how long you have held your shares in the Fund. Capital gain dividends of a non-corporate U.S. shareholder recognized during a tax year beginning before January 1, 2013 generally will be taxed at a maximum rate of 15%. Distributions of net short-term capital gain (that is, the excess of any net short-term capital gain over net long-term capital loss), if any, will be taxable to shareholders as ordinary income. Capital gain of a corporate shareholder is taxed at the same rate as ordinary income.
entries.zh: 超过一年投资的出售净收益，高于持有一年或以下投资出售净损失的部分），如适当指定为资本利得股息，不论持有基金多久，均按长期资本利得征税。非公司美国持有人在2013年1月1日前开始的应税年度确认的资本利得股息，一般最高税率15%。短期净资本利得（短期净利得高于长期净损失的部分）分配，按普通收入征税。公司持有人的资本利得税率与普通收入相同。

entries.source: If you buy shares just before distribution, you will pay tax on the entire amount of the taxable distribution you receive. Distributions are taxable to you even if they are paid from income or gain earned by the Fund before your investment (and thus were included in the price you paid for your Fund shares). Any gain resulting from the sale or exchange of Fund shares will be taxable as long-term or short-term gain, depending upon how long you have held your shares.
entries.zh: 分配前刚购买的，仍须对收到的全部应税分配纳税，即使收入或利得在购买前已经赚取并包含在购买份额价格内。出售或交换产生的收益，依持有期按长期或短期利得处理。

entries.source: The Fund’s investment in foreign securities may be subject to foreign withholding taxes or other taxes. In that case, the Fund’s yield on those securities would be decreased. In addition, the Fund’s investment in certain foreign securities or foreign currencies may increase or accelerate the Fund’s recognition of ordinary income and may affect the timing or amount of Fund distributions.
entries.zh: 外国证券可承担外国预扣或其他税款，使收益减少。某些外国证券及货币投资也可以增加或提前普通收入确认，影响分配时间或金额。

entries.source: The Fund’s investments in certain REIT securities, debt obligations and derivative instruments may cause the Fund to recognize taxable income in excess of the cash generated by such obligations. In order to generate sufficient cash to make the requisite distributions, the Fund may be required to liquidate other investments in its portfolio that it otherwise would have continued to hold, including when it is not advantageous to do so. The Fund’s investment in REIT securities also may result in the Fund’s receipt of cash in excess of the REIT’s earnings; if the Fund distributes such amounts, such distributions could constitute a return of capital to Fund shareholders for federal income tax purposes.
entries.zh: 某些REIT、债务及衍生工具，可使确认的应税收入超过产生的现金。为取得必要分配现金，基金可能出售本希望继续持有的资产，包括在不利时点出售。REIT投资也可产生超过其盈利的现金，基金将其分配时，可构成联邦所得税下的资本返还。

entries.source: The Fund’s transactions in futures contracts, swaps and other derivatives will be subject to special tax rules, the effect of which may be to accelerate income to the Fund, defer losses to the Fund, cause adjustments in the holding periods of the Fund’s securities, and convert short-term capital losses into long-term capital losses. These rules could therefore affect the amount, timing and character of distributions to shareholders. The Fund’s use of these types of transactions may result in the Fund realizing more short-term capital gain and ordinary income subject to tax at ordinary income tax rates than it would if it did not engage in such transactions.
entries.zh: 期货、掉期及其他衍生工具适用特殊税务规则，可提前收入、递延损失、调整证券持有期，并将短期资本损失转为长期损失，影响分配金额、时间和性质。其使用可使基金比未使用时确认更多按普通税率征税的短期利得及普通收入。

entries.zh: 持有人信息（续）

entries.source: The extent to which the Fund can invest in MLPs is limited by the Fund’s intention to qualify as a regulated investment company under the Internal Revenue Code.
entries.zh: 基金MLP投资受按《国内税收法》维持受监管投资公司资格的意图限制。

entries.source: Please see the Statement of Additional Information for additional discussion of the tax consequences of the above-described and other investments to the Fund and its shareholders.
entries.zh: 上述及其他投资对基金及持有人的税务后果，详见补充信息说明书。

entries.source: The dates on which dividends and capital gain, if any, will be distributed are available online at www.jpmorganfunds.com.
entries.zh: 股息及资本利得（如有）分配日期，可在［匿名化产品网站］查询。

entries.source: Early in each calendar year, the Fund will send you a notice showing the amount of distributions you received in the preceding year and the tax status of those distributions.
entries.zh: 每年初，基金发出上一年分配金额及税务性质通知。

entries.source: Any investor for whom the Fund does not have a valid Taxpayer Identification Number may be subject to backup withholding.
entries.zh: 未提供有效税务识别号码的投资者可能适用备用预扣税。

entries.source: The Fund is not intended for foreign shareholders. Any foreign shareholders would generally be subject to U.S. tax withholding on distributions by the Fund, as discussed in the Statement of Additional Information.
entries.zh: 本基金并非面向外国持有人。外国持有人一般须就基金分配承担美国预扣税，详情见补充信息说明书。

entries.source: The tax considerations described in this section do not apply to tax-deferred accounts or other non-taxable entities.
entries.zh: 本节税务考虑不适用于税务递延账户或其他非应税实体。

entries.source: The above is a general summary of tax implications of investing in the Fund. Because each investor’s tax consequences are unique, please consult your tax advisor to see how investing in the Fund will affect your own tax situation.
entries.zh: 以上为投资基金税务影响的一般概述。每人税务后果不同，请咨询税务顾问了解个人影响。

entries.zh: 持有人对账单及报告

entries.source: The Fund or your Financial Intermediary will send you transaction confirmation statements and quarterly account statements. Please review these statements carefully. The Fund will correct errors if notified within one year of the date printed on the transaction confirmation or account statement. Your Financial Intermediary may have a different cut-off time. J.P. Morgan Funds will charge a fee for requests for statements that are older than two years. Please retain all of your statements, as they could be needed for tax purposes.
entries.zh: 基金或中介发送交易确认及季度账户报告。请认真检查；打印日起一年内通知的错误，基金予以更正。中介可有不同期限。超过两年的对账单补发收费。请保留全部记录，税务办理可能需要。

entries.source: To reduce expenses and conserve natural resources, the Fund will deliver a single copy of prospectuses and financial reports to individual investors who share a residential address, provided they have the same last name or the Fund reasonably believes they are members of the same family. If you would like to receive separate mailings, please call 1-800-480-4111 and the Fund will begin individual delivery within 30 days. If you would like to receive these documents by e-mail, please visit www.jpmorganfunds.com and sign up for electronic delivery.
entries.zh: 为减少费用及节约资源，同住且同姓或被合理认为属于同一家庭的个人投资者，合并收到一份说明书及财务报告。如需分开寄送，请联系［匿名化服务电话］，30日内开始。电子送达请在［匿名化产品网站］登记。

entries.source: If you are the record owner of your Fund shares (that is, you did not use a Financial Intermediary to buy your shares), you may access your account statements at www.jpmorganfunds.com.
entries.zh: 直接登记持有人，即未通过中介购买者，可在［匿名化产品网站］查阅账户报告。

entries.source: After each fiscal half-year, you will receive a financial report from the Fund. In addition, the Fund will periodically send you proxy statements and other reports.
entries.zh: 每个财务半年度后，收到一份财务报告；基金还不时发送代理表决及其他报告。

entries.source: If you have any questions or need additional information, please write to the J.P. Morgan Funds Services at P.O. Box 8528, Boston, MA 02266-8528, call 1-800-480-4111 or visit www.jpmorganfunds.com.
entries.zh: 问题或其他资料请求，可写信至M基金服务机构［匿名化通讯地址］，联系［匿名化服务电话］或访问［匿名化产品网站］。

entries.source: AVAILABILITY OF PROXY VOTING RECORD
entries.zh: 代理投票记录的获取

entries.source: The Trustees have delegated the authority to vote proxies for securities owned by the Fund to JPMIM. A copy of the Fund’s voting record for the most recent 12-month period ended June 30 is available on the SEC’s website at www.sec.gov or on the J.P. Morgan Funds’ website at www.jpmorganfunds.com no later than August 31 of each year. The Fund’s proxy voting record will include, among other things, a brief description of the matter voted on for each portfolio security, and will state how each vote was cast, for example, for or against the proposal.
entries.zh: 受托人将组合证券的代理投票权委托MIM。最近截至6月30日的12个月投票记录，于每年8月31日前在SEC网站或［匿名化产品网站］提供。记录包括每项证券的投票事项简述及投票方向，例如赞成或反对。

entries.source: PORTFOLIO HOLDINGS DISCLOSURE
entries.zh: 组合持仓披露

entries.source: No sooner than 30 days after the end of each month, the Fund will make available upon request an uncertified, complete schedule of its portfolio holdings as of the last day of that month. Not later than 60 days after the end of each fiscal quarter, the Fund will make available a complete schedule of its portfolio holdings as of the last day of that quarter. In addition, from time to time, the Fund may post portfolio holdings on the J.P. Morgan Funds’ website on a more timely basis.
entries.zh: 月末至少30日之后，基金可应请求提供该月末未经认证的完整持仓表；季度末不晚于60日提供该季度末完整持仓表。基金还可不时更及时地在产品网站发布持仓。

entries.source: In addition to providing hard copies upon request, the Fund will post these quarterly schedules on the J.P. Morgan Funds’ web-site at www.jpmorganfunds.com and on the SEC’s website at www.sec.gov.
entries.zh: 除按请求提供纸质资料外，季度表也在产品网站及SEC网站发布。

entries.source: The Fund will disclose the Fund’s 10 largest portfolio holdings and the percentage that each of these 10 largest portfolio holdings represents of the Fund’s total assets as of the most recent month end online at www.jpmorganfunds.com, no sooner than 10 calendar days after month end.
entries.zh: 月末至少10个日历日后，在［匿名化产品网站］披露最新月末十大持仓及各自占基金总资产比例。

entries.source: In addition, the top five holdings that contributed to Fund performance and top five holdings that detracted from Fund performance are also posted on the J.P. Morgan Funds’ website at www.jpmorganfunds.com no sooner than 10 calendar days after month end.
entries.zh: 对基金表现贡献最大及拖累最大的各五项持仓，也于月末至少10个日历日后发布。

entries.source: Shareholders may request portfolio holdings schedules at no charge by calling 1-800-480-4111. A description of the Fund’s policies and procedures with respect to the disclosure of the Fund’s portfolio holdings is available in the Statement of Additional Information.
entries.zh: 持有人可通过［匿名化服务电话］免费请求持仓表。持仓披露政策及程序见补充信息说明书。

entries.zh: M系列美国股票基金

entries.source: Risk and Reward Elements for the Fund
entries.zh: 基金的风险与回报元素

entries.source: This table discusses the main elements that may make up the Fund’s overall risk and reward characteristics. It also outlines the policies toward various investments, including those that are designed to help the Fund manage risk.
entries.zh: 下表讨论可能构成基金总体风险及回报特征的主要元素，也列示各种投资的有关政策，包括旨在协助管理风险的政策。

entries.source: POTENTIAL RISKS
entries.zh: 潜在风险

entries.source: POTENTIAL REWARDS
entries.zh: 潜在回报

entries.source: POLICIES TO BALANCE RISK AND REWARD
entries.zh: 平衡风险与回报的政策

entries.source: Market conditions affecting
entries.zh: 影响权益证券的

entries.source: equity securities
entries.zh: 市场条件

entries.source: Ÿ The Fund’s share price and performance will fluctuate in response to stock market movements
entries.zh: • 基金份额价格及表现随股票市场变动而波动。

entries.source: Ÿ The market value of convertible securities and other debt securities tends to fall when prevailing interest rates rise. The value of convertible securities also tends to change whenever the market value of the underlying common or preferred stock fluctuates
entries.zh: • 市场利率上升时，可转换证券及其他债务证券市值通常下跌。底层普通股或优先股市值变化时，可转换证券价值也通常变化。

entries.source: Ÿ Adverse market, economic, political or other conditions may from time to time cause the Fund to take temporary defensive positions that are inconsistent with its principal investment strategies and may hinder the Fund from achieving its investment objective
entries.zh: • 不利市场、经济、政治或其他条件，可能使基金不时采取与主要策略不一致的临时防御性头寸，妨碍实现目标。

entries.source: Ÿ Stocks have generally outperformed more stable investments (such as bonds and cash equivalents) over the long term
entries.zh: • 长期而言，股票一般优于债券及现金等价物等较稳定投资。

entries.source: Ÿ Under normal circumstances the Fund plans to remain fully invested in accordance with its policies and the Fund may invest uninvested cash in affiliated money market funds; in addition to the securities described in the “What are the Fund’s main investment strategies?” section, equity securities may include common stocks, convertible securities1, preferred stocks2, depositary receipts, (such as American Depositary Receipts and European Depositary Receipts), trust or partnership interests, warrants and rights3 and investment company securities
entries.zh: • 正常情况下，拟按政策保持充分投资，未投入现金可投资关联货币市场基金。除“基金的主要投资策略是什么？”所述工具外，权益证券还可包括普通股、可转换证券¹、优先股²、美国及欧洲存托凭证等存托凭证、信托或合伙权益、认股权证及认股权³，以及投资公司证券。

entries.source: Ÿ The Fund seeks to limit risk and enhance performance through active management and/or diversification
entries.zh: • 通过主动管理及／或分散化限制风险、提高表现。

entries.source: Ÿ During severe market downturns, the Fund has the option of investing up to 100% of its total assets in high quality, short-term instruments
entries.zh: • 市场严重下跌时，可将不超过总资产100%的金额投入高质量短期工具。

entries.source: Convertible securities are bonds or preferred stock that can convert to common stock.
entries.zh: 可转换证券为可以转换成普通股的债券或优先股。

entries.source: Preferred stock is a class of stock that generally pays a dividend at a specified rate and has preference over common stock in the payment of dividends and in liquidation.
entries.zh: 优先股通常按指定率支付股息，并在股息支付和清算时优先于普通股。

entries.source: Warrants and rights are securities, typically issued with preferred stock or bonds, that give the holder the right to buy a proportionate amount of common stock at a specified price.
entries.zh: 认股权证及认股权通常与优先股或债券同时发行，赋予以指定价格购买一定比例普通股的权利。

entries.source: Risk and Reward Elements for the Fund (continued)
entries.zh: 基金的风险与回报元素（续）

entries.zh: 潜在风险

entries.source: POTENTIAL REWARDS
entries.zh: 潜在回报

entries.source: POLICIES TO BALANCE RISK AND REWARD
entries.zh: 平衡风险与回报的政策

entries.source: Management choices
entries.zh: 管理选择

entries.source: Ÿ The Fund could underperform its benchmark due to its securities and asset allocation choices
entries.zh: • 证券及资产配置选择可使表现低于基准。

entries.source: Ÿ The Fund could outperform its benchmark due to these same choices
entries.zh: • 相同选择也可使表现高于基准。

entries.source: Ÿ The adviser focuses its active management on securities selection, the area where it believes its commitment to research can most enhance returns and manage risks in a consistent way
entries.zh: • 顾问将主动管理集中于证券选择，认为其研究投入在此领域最能提高回报并一致地管理风险。

entries.source: Derivatives*
entries.zh: 衍生工具*

entries.source: Ÿ Derivatives such as futures, options, swaps and forward foreign currency contracts1 that are used for hedging the portfolio or specific securities may not fully offset the underlying positions and this could result in losses to the Fund that would not have otherwise occurred
entries.zh: • 用于组合或个别证券对冲的期货、期权、掉期及远期外汇合约¹，可能不能充分抵销底层头寸，造成原本不会发生的损失。

entries.source: Ÿ The Fund may have difficulty exiting a derivatives position
entries.zh: • 可能难以退出衍生头寸。

entries.source: Ÿ Derivatives used for risk management or to increase the Fund’s gain may not have the intended effects and may result in losses or missed opportunities
entries.zh: • 用于风险管理或提高收益的工具可能无预期效果，造成损失或错失机会。

entries.source: Ÿ The counterparty to a derivatives contract could default
entries.zh: • 合约对手方可能违约。

entries.source: Ÿ Derivatives that involve leverage could magnify losses
entries.zh: • 杠杆衍生工具可以放大损失。

entries.source: Ÿ Certain types of derivatives involve costs to the Fund which can reduce returns
entries.zh: • 某些工具的成本会减少回报。

entries.source: Ÿ Segregated or earmarked assets and collateral accounts established in connection with derivatives may limit the Fund’s investment flexibility
entries.zh: • 为衍生交易设立的隔离或标记资产及担保账户，可能限制投资灵活性。

entries.source: Ÿ Derivatives used for non-hedging purposes could cause losses that exceed the original investment
entries.zh: • 非对冲工具可造成超过最初投入的损失。

entries.source: Ÿ Derivatives may, for tax purposes, affect the character of gain and loss realized by the Fund, accelerate recognition of income to the Fund, affect the holding period of the Fund’s assets and defer recognition of certain of a Fund’s losses
entries.zh: • 为税务目的，可以影响已实现利得和损失性质、提前确认收入、影响资产持有期及递延某些损失。

entries.source: Ÿ Hedges that correlate well with underlying positions can reduce or eliminate losses at low cost
entries.zh: • 与底层头寸相关性良好的对冲，可以较低成本减少或消除损失。

entries.source: Ÿ The Fund could make money and protect against losses if management’s analysis proves correct
entries.zh: • 管理分析正确时，可以获利并防止损失。

entries.source: Ÿ Derivatives that involve leverage could generate substantial gains at low cost
entries.zh: • 杠杆工具可以较低成本取得较大收益。

entries.source: Ÿ The Fund may use derivatives to more effectively gain targeted equity exposure from its cash positions, for hedging and for risk management (i.e., to adjust duration or yield curve exposure or to establish or adjust exposure to particular securities, markets or currencies); risk management may include management of the Fund’s exposure relative to its benchmark. The Fund may also use derivatives in an effort to enhance returns
entries.zh: • 可用于更有效地从现金取得目标股票敞口、对冲及风险管理，例如调整久期或收益率曲线敞口，或建立和调整特定证券、市场或货币敞口。风险管理可包括相对于基准管理敞口。也可用于提高回报。

entries.source: Ÿ The Fund only establishes hedges that it expects will be highly correlated with underlying positions
entries.zh: • 仅设立预期与底层头寸高度相关的对冲。

entries.source: Ÿ While the Fund may use derivatives that incidentally involve leverage, it does not use them for the specific purpose of leveraging its portfolio
entries.zh: • 虽可使用附带形成杠杆的工具，但不以杠杆化组合为特定目的。

entries.source: Ÿ The Fund segregates or earmarks liquid assets to cover its derivatives and offset a portion of the leverage risk
entries.zh: • 隔离或标记流动资产以覆盖衍生工具，并抵销部分杠杆风险。

entries.source: The Fund is not subject to registration or regulation as a “commodity pool operator” as defined in the Commodity Exchange Act because the Fund has claimed an exclusion from that definition.
entries.zh: 基金已申请不属于《商品交易法》“商品池运营者”定义的排除，因此不须以该身份注册或接受监管。

entries.source: A futures contract is an agreement to buy or sell a set quantity of an underlying instrument at a future date, or to make or receive a cash payment based on changes in the value of a securities index. An option is the right to buy or sell a set quantity of an underlying instrument at a predetermined price. A swap is a privately negotiated agreement to exchange one stream of payments for another. A forward foreign currency contract is an obligation to buy or sell a given currency on a future date and at a set price.
entries.zh: 期货合约为在未来日期买卖指定数量底层工具，或根据证券指数变化收付现金的协议。期权为以预定价格买卖指定数量底层工具的权利。掉期为私下协商、交换付款流的协议。远期外汇合约为于未来日期以固定价格买卖指定货币的义务。

entries.zh: 潜在风险

entries.source: POLICIES TO BALANCE RISK AND REWARD
entries.zh: 平衡风险与回报的政策

entries.source: Exchange Traded Funds (ETFs)1 and other investment companies
entries.zh: 交易所交易基金（ETF）¹及其他投资公司

entries.source: Ÿ If the Fund invests in shares of another investment company, shareholders would bear not only their proportionate share of the Fund’s expenses, but also similar expenses of the investment company
entries.zh: • 投资其他投资公司份额时，持有人除承担基金按比例支出外，还承担被投资公司的类似支出。

entries.source: Ÿ The price movement of an ETF (whether passively or actively managed) may not track the underlying index, market, sector, regions or industries and may result in a loss
entries.zh: • 被动或主动ETF价格可能不跟随底层指数、市场、板块、地区或行业，造成损失。

entries.source: Ÿ Investments in other investment companies help to manage smaller cash flows
entries.zh: • 其他投资公司投资可帮助管理较小现金流。

entries.source: Ÿ Investing in ETFs offers instant exposure to an index or a broad range of markets, sectors, geographic regions and industries
entries.zh: • ETF可以立即取得指数或广泛市场、板块、地区及行业敞口。

entries.source: Ÿ Generally, the Fund’s investments in other investment companies, including ETFs, are subject to the percentage limitations of the Investment Company Act of 1940 (1940 Act)
entries.zh: • 一般受《1940年投资公司法》的比例限制。

entries.source: Ÿ Exemptive orders granted to various iShares funds (which are ETFs), other ETFs, and their investment advisers by the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) permit the Fund to invest beyond the 1940 Act limits, subject to certain terms and conditions, including a finding of the Board of Trustees that the advisory fees charged by the Fund’s adviser are for services that are in addition to, and not duplicative of, the advisory services provided to those ETFs
entries.zh: • SEC对若干ETF及其顾问的豁免令，在满足条件时允许超过法定比例，包括受托人委员会认定本基金顾问收费所对应服务是ETF顾问服务之外的额外服务，而非重复服务。

entries.source: Ÿ Under SEC Rule 12d1-1, the Fund may invest in both affiliated and unaffiliated money market funds without limit subject to the Fund’s investment policies and restrictions and the conditions of the rule
entries.zh: • 依SEC第12d1-1条，可在基金投资政策、限制及规则条件内，不受数量限制地投资关联及非关联货币市场基金。

entries.source: Foreign investments
entries.zh: 外国投资

entries.source: Ÿ Currency exchange rate movements could reduce gains or create losses
entries.zh: • 汇率变动可以减少利得或造成损失。

entries.source: Ÿ The Fund could lose money because of foreign government actions, political instability or lack of adequate and accurate information
entries.zh: • 外国政府行动、政治不稳定或缺乏充分准确资料可能造成损失。

entries.source: Ÿ Currency and investment risks tend to be higher in emerging markets; these markets also present higher liquidity and valuation risks
entries.zh: • 新兴市场货币及投资风险通常较高，流动性及估值风险也较高。

entries.source: Ÿ Favorable exchange rate movements could generate gains or reduce losses
entries.zh: • 有利汇率变化可以增加收益或减少损失。

entries.source: Ÿ Foreign investments, which represent a major portion of the world’s securities, offer attractive potential performance and opportunities for diversification
entries.zh: • 外国证券占全球证券的重要部分，提供潜在表现及分散化机会。

entries.source: Ÿ Emerging markets can offer higher returns
entries.zh: • 新兴市场可提供较高回报。

entries.source: Ÿ The Fund anticipates that total foreign investments will not exceed 20% of total assets
entries.zh: • 预计外国投资合计不超过总资产20%。

entries.source: Ÿ The Fund may actively manage the currency exposure of its foreign investments relative to its benchmarks, and may hedge back into the U.S. dollar from time to time (see also “Derivatives”); these currency management techniques may not be available for certain emerging markets investments
entries.zh: • 可主动管理外国投资相对于基准的货币敞口，并不时对冲回美元（另见“衍生工具”）；某些新兴市场投资可能不能使用这些方法。

entries.source: Passively managed ETFs generally seek to track the performance of a particular market index, including broad-based market indexes, as well as indexes relating to particular sectors, markets, regions or industries. Actively managed ETFs do not seek to track the performance of a particular market index.
entries.zh: 被动ETF一般跟踪特定市场指数，包括广泛市场及特定板块、市场、地区或行业指数。主动ETF不寻求跟踪特定市场指数。

entries.zh: 潜在风险

entries.source: POTENTIAL REWARDS
entries.zh: 潜在回报

entries.source: POLICIES TO BALANCE RISK AND REWARD
entries.zh: 平衡风险与回报的政策

entries.source: Master Limited Partnerships (MLPs)
entries.zh: 主有限合伙企业（MLP）

entries.source: Ÿ Holders of MLP units have limited control and voting rights, similar to those of a limited partner
entries.zh: • MLP持有人的控制及投票权有限，类似有限合伙人。

entries.source: Ÿ An MLP could be taxed, contrary to its intention, as a corporation, resulting in decreased returns
entries.zh: • MLP可能与其意图相反，按公司征税，减少回报。

entries.source: Ÿ MLPs may, for tax purposes, affect the character of the gain and loss realized by the Fund and affect the holding period of the Fund’s assets
entries.zh: • 为税务目的，可影响基金利得和损失性质及资产持有期。

entries.source: Ÿ MLPs can offer attractive returns
entries.zh: • 可提供有吸引力的回报。

entries.source: Ÿ MLPs may offer more attractive yields or potential growth than comparable equity securities
entries.zh: • 相比可比权益证券，可能提供更有吸引力的收益率或潜在增长。

entries.source: Ÿ MLPs offer attractive potential performance and opportunities for diversification
entries.zh: • 提供潜在表现及分散化机会。

entries.source: Ÿ The Fund will limit its direct and indirect investments in MLPs to maintain its status as a registered investment company
entries.zh: • 限制直接及间接MLP投资，以维持注册投资公司身份。

entries.source: Ÿ The Fund anticipates that its total investments in MLPs will not exceed 10% of total assets
entries.zh: • 预计MLP总投资不超过总资产10%。

entries.source: Real Estate Investment Trusts (REITs)1
entries.zh: 房地产投资信托基金（REIT）¹

entries.source: Ÿ The value of real estate securities in general, and REITs in particular, are subject to the same risks as direct investments in real estate and will depend on the value of the underlying properties or the underlying loans or interests
entries.zh: • 房地产证券及REIT承担与直接房地产投资相同的风险，取决于底层物业、贷款或权益价值。

entries.source: Ÿ The value of these securities will rise and fall in response to many factors, including economic conditions, the demand for rental property and interest rates. In particular, the value of these securities may decline when interest rates rise and will also be affected by the real estate market and by the management of the underlying properties
entries.zh: • 价值随经济条件、租赁需求和利率等变动；利率上升时可能下降，也受房地产市场及底层物业管理影响。

entries.source: Ÿ REITs may be more volatile and/or more illiquid than other types of equity securities
entries.zh: • REIT可能比其他股票更波动及／或更不流动。

entries.source: Ÿ If a REIT fails to distribute its required taxable income or to satisfy the other requirements of REIT status, it would be taxed as a corporation, and amounts available for distribution to shareholders (including the Fund) would be reduced by any corporate taxes payable by the REIT
entries.zh: • 未分配规定应税收入或未满足REIT身份条件时，将按公司征税，可分配金额因公司税减少。

entries.source: Ÿ The Fund can gain exposure to an additional asset class in order to further diversify its assets
entries.zh: • 获得额外资产类别敞口，进一步分散资产。

entries.source: Ÿ The Fund may receive current income from its REIT investments
entries.zh: • 可从REIT取得当期收入。

entries.source: Ÿ If a REIT meets the requirements of the Internal Revenue Code, as amended, it will not be taxed on income it distributes to its shareholders; as a result, more income can be distributed by the REIT
entries.zh: • 符合修订后的《国内税收法》时，不对分配收入征税，因此可分配更多收入。

entries.source: Ÿ The Fund’s adviser will carefully evaluate particular REITs before and after investment based on its investment process and will also monitor economic and real estate trends affecting the value of REITs

entries.source: REITs are pooled investment vehicles which invest primarily in income-producing real estate or loans related to real estate.
